entries.title: Amos 6:1
segments: ¶Woe to them [that are] at ease in Zion, and trust in the mountain of Samaria, [which are] named chief of the nations, to whom the house of Israel came! {are at...: or, are secure} {chief: or, firstfruits}

entries.title: Amos 6:2
segments: Pass ye unto Calneh, and see; and from thence go ye to Hamath the great: then go down to Gath of the Philistines: [be they] better than these kingdoms? or their border greater than your border?

entries.title: Amos 6:3
segments: Ye that put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near; {seat: or, habitation}

entries.title: Amos 6:4
segments: That lie upon beds of ivory, and stretch themselves upon their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves out of the midst of the stall; {stretch...: or, abound with superfluities}

entries.title: Amos 6:5
segments: That chant to the sound of the viol, [and] invent to themselves instruments of musick, like David; {chant: or, quaver}

entries.title: Amos 6:6
segments: That drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the chief ointments: but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph. {wine...: or, in bowls of wine} {affliction: Heb. breach}

words.text: . {wine...: or, in bowls of wine} {affliction: Heb. breach}

entries.title: Amos 6:7
segments: Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive, and the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed.

words.text: Therefore now shall they go captive

entries.title: Amos 6:8
segments: ¶The Lord GOD hath sworn by himself, saith the LORD the God of hosts, I abhor the excellency of Jacob, and hate his palaces: therefore will I deliver up the city with all that is therein. {that...: Heb. the fulness thereof}

entries.title: Amos 6:9
segments: And it shall come to pass, if there remain ten men in one house, that they shall die.

words.text: And it shall come to pass, if there remain

entries.title: Amos 6:10
segments: And a man's uncle shall take him up, and he that burneth him, to bring out the bones out of the house, and shall say unto him that [is] by the sides of the house, [Is there] yet [any] with thee? and he shall say, No. Then shall he say, Hold thy tongue: for we may not make mention of the name of the LORD. {we...: or, they will not, or, have not}

entries.title: Amos 6:11
segments: For, behold, the LORD commandeth, and he will smite the great house with breaches, and the little house with clefts. {breaches: or, droppings}

entries.title: Amos 6:12
segments: Shall horses run upon the rock? will [one] plow [there] with oxen? for ye have turned judgment into gall, and the fruit of righteousness into hemlock:

entries.title: Amos 6:13
segments: Ye which rejoice in a thing of nought, which say, Have we not taken to us horns by our own strength?

entries.title: Amos 6:14
segments: But, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, O house of Israel, saith the LORD the God of hosts; and they shall afflict you from the entering in of Hemath unto the river of the wilderness. {river: or, valley}
